t: The Sovereign Symbiote: Forging a Skill-Based Partnership with AI
s: This article advocates for a sovereign, skill-based human-AI symbiosis, contrasting invasive tech with a user-controlled, extension-of-self integration via tools like Vim and CLI workflows, emphasizing agency and seamless delegation.
sub: Skill-based human-AI symbiosis as an extension of self (exosymbiosis)
Maintaining user agency and sovereignty over AI integration
Command-line interface (CLI) and Vim workflow for high-bandwidth, low-friction AI interaction
Critique of GUI-based development environments and invasive technologies
